base_body_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: project-bound gpt-image-2 source asset for a Live2D-riggable iOS magic sticker wardrobe base body. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no phone UI, no cropped limbs, no fused fingers, no realistic photo, do not use #00ff00 or green anywhere in the character.

notes: No Pencil output is used for the committed avatar asset.
